findings.detail: issuer_name is populated with concatenated schedule fields instead of only the source issuer cell; Passport Labs source issuer is only Passport Labs, Inc.

rationale: C206 is a Class 2 within-row issuer_name contamination flag. The raw schedule row separates issuer, investment, acquisition date, reference rate, interest rate, cost, and fair value into distinct cells. The stored issuer_name for the flagged Passport Labs row concatenates the investment description, maturity, acquisition date, reference rate, and interest rate into issuer_name, while the source issuer cell is only Passport Labs, Inc.; American Achievement shows the same source column structure. This grounds a real extraction/column mapping error rather than a false alarm.
